descripcion: The curator invites you to get to know the stoa: the fountain courtyard and, at the far end, the critic.

pasos.texto: Go through the door and look into the fountain courtyard
Find the critic in the north portico, next to the mural

textos.aceptada: The curator will be glad to see you back whenever you like. The mission book (key J) shows you the way.
textos.completada: You now know the stoa. The curator has another task for you.

notas: Gallery template: the welcome walk. It works with an empty gallery and with a full one.
